name: Aasimar
summary: Mortals touched by celestial power, often guided by an angelic voice. Aasimar can heal with a touch and, as they grow, unleash radiant or deathly power.

age.summary: Aasimar mature like humans but can live up to 160 years.

alignment.summary: Most aasimar are good, though some fall from that path.

speed.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

languages.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Celestial.

features.name: Darkvision
features.summary: You see in dim light within 60 feet as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light (shades of gray only).

features.name: Celestial Resistance
features.summary: You have resistance to necrotic and radiant damage.

features.name: Healing Hands
features.summary: As an action, touch a creature to restore hit points equal to your level. Once per long rest.

action.short: Touch a creature and restore {level} hit points.

features.name: Light Bearer
features.summary: You know the light cantrip. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it.

sublineages.name: Protector Aasimar
sublineages.summary: Charged by the powers of good to guard the weak.

features.name: Radiant Soul
features.summary: From 3rd level, as an action you sprout spectral wings for 1 minute: you fly at 30 feet, and once per turn one attack or spell deals extra radiant damage equal to your level. Once per long rest.

action.short: Spectral wings for 1 minute: fly 30 ft., +{level} radiant damage once per turn.

sublineages.name: Scourge Aasimar
sublineages.summary: Filled with a burning divine fire that hungers to destroy evil.

features.name: Radiant Consumption
features.summary: From 3rd level, as an action you blaze with light for 1 minute: you and creatures within 10 feet take radiant damage equal to half your level each turn, and once per turn you deal extra radiant damage equal to your level. Once per long rest.

action.short: Blaze for 1 minute: {halfLevel} radiant to you and nearby creatures each turn, +{level} radiant once per turn.

sublineages.name: Fallen Aasimar
sublineages.summary: Once touched by light, now marked by darkness.

features.name: Necrotic Shroud
features.summary: From 3rd level, as an action you turn ghostly for 1 minute: nearby creatures must make a CHA save or be frightened of you, and once per turn you deal extra necrotic damage equal to your level. Once per long rest.

action.short: Turn ghostly for 1 minute: nearby creatures save or are frightened, +{level} necrotic once per turn.
